items.title: Kyoto official flood geometry closure
items.current_blocker: A31b receipt is READY_FOR_INGESTION but no reviewed Kiyomizu or Arashiyama AOI clip exists; connected cities/layers are zero and closure_derived is false.
supported_claims: Verified overlap identifies a source/version/scenario-bound impact candidate.
unsupported_claims: Overlap is edge closure or passability failure.
items.contradiction: S006 A31a documentation does not independently verify the exact A31b city/mesh archive.
items.smallest_admissible_resolution: Hash-bound raw receipt and deterministic reviewed AOI clip with license, CRS, scenario/year and source-feature lineage.
items.happy_path_test: Reproduce the valid in-AOI clip from the raw SHA and resolve every output feature to a source ID.
items.fail_closed_test: Remove any license, revision, CRS, raw/output SHA, scenario or feature-ID receipt; remain NOT_CONNECTED and derive no closure.
items.human_freeze_trigger: Any overlap-to-closure mapping, threshold, or safety/accessibility claim.

items.title: Fujisawa official tsunami geometry closure
items.current_blocker: The A40 Kanagawa tsunami source has no approved license receipt or promoted Enoshima official geometry.
official_receipts: human-reviewed prefectural license, secondary-use terms and currentness
national or prefectural product relationship to the Fujisawa municipal attachment
supported_claims: A verified official product may provide scenario-bound inundation candidates with explicit uncertainty.
unsupported_claims: Geometry establishes pedestrian or wheelchair traversability.
Geometry establishes closure or safety outside the polygon.
items.contradiction: National modelling guidance constrains interpretation but does not prove the exact local package or license.
items.smallest_admissible_resolution: Human-approved prefectural terms/currentness and municipal-attachment relationship, plus a hash-bound exact package and deterministic AOI clip preserving uncertainty and feature lineage.
items.happy_path_test: Reproduce stable clip hashes/source IDs and retain scenario metadata from the licensed exact package.
items.fail_closed_test: Withhold prefectural license/currentness, Fujisawa attachment relationship or any package/CRS/scenario/provenance field; remain NOT_CONNECTED and set no closure, damage or debris.
items.human_freeze_trigger: Legal interpretation, uncertainty suppression, passage threshold, or route/safety claim.

items.title: PLATEAU package and 3D delivery closure
items.current_blocker: Connected cities are zero and real_tileset is false; package license, integrity, CRS, AOI, root/child and CORS receipts are incomplete.
supported_claims: Separately verified source semantics and delivery receipts establish bounded 3D portrayal capability.
unsupported_claims: Rendered tiles prove semantic completeness or accessibility.
items.contradiction: PLATEAU 5.1 is a current interpretation/delta reference, not proof that FY2025/v5 packages conform to 5.1; CityGML semantics and 3D Tiles delivery are distinct.
items.smallest_admissible_resolution: Validate each package against its declared v5 schema/spec and verify a bounded derivative or complete delivery receipt while retaining deterministic 2D fallback.
items.happy_path_test: Verify hashes, CRS, classes, AOI and all required root/child/CORS requests.
items.fail_closed_test: Remove city code/catalog/version, terms/PDL verification, integrity, CRS, AOI, root/child or CORS receipt; remain NOT_CONNECTED with real_tileset false and use 2D fallback.
items.human_freeze_trigger: Semantic equivalence, accessibility inference, production 3D connection, or fallback removal.

items.title: Official facility row and operation closure
items.current_blocker: Connected sources are zero; landing-page metadata has no reviewed rows with direct coordinates, and operational/accessibility fields remain null with reasons.
official_receipts: authoritative row-level original/source/version/license for each scoped inventory category
direct official coordinates or separately approved geocode
per-field operation, entrance, capacity, fire_safe and accessibility provenance
supported_claims: A source-traceable official row establishes bounded existence/location; separate timestamped evidence may support individual operational fields.
unsupported_claims: Existence or an address proves operation, capacity, entrance, fire_safe, accessibility or route suitability.
items.contradiction: Visibility/fetchability, existence and current operation are distinct; normative guidance is not site observation.
items.smallest_admissible_resolution: Connect one bounded licensed row-level source with stable ID/direct coordinates and keep every unevidenced field null with reason.
items.happy_path_test: Round-trip source ID/version/coordinates and populate only explicitly evidenced fields.
items.fail_closed_test: Provide only landing page, address, existence or a subset of categories; do not geocode or infer operational/accessibility fields, remain unconnected and keep missing categories as open gaps.
items.human_freeze_trigger: Geocoding, legal/operational interpretation, capacity, fire_safe, accessibility or public facility claim.

items.title: Complete per-field M7 evidence for selected real edges
items.current_blocker: Fifteen selected edges have zero structurally callable, evidence-ready or computed M7 results; M6 remains independently NOT_COMPUTED.
official_receipts: complete left/right buildings and nested evidence
supported_claims: Only a structurally complete source-traceable packet may be submitted to the existing frozen M7 API.
unsupported_claims: Infer width, setback, damage or debris.
Treat missing sides as empty or values as zero.
Treat geometry provenance as M7 evidence readiness.
items.contradiction: Moya and the frozen AblePath M7 contract are not interchangeable; population and local-transfer limits remain explicit.
items.smallest_admissible_resolution: One selected edge receives a complete independently reviewed per-field packet matching the frozen API; all other incomplete edges remain NOT_COMPUTED.
items.happy_path_test: A hand-calculated complete fixture calls the frozen API once and matches documented physical residual-width outputs and variant while preserving official-closure/hazard metadata and all receipts.
items.fail_closed_test: Remove each required value or provenance in turn; do not call the API and emit null NOT_COMPUTED with missing field and reason.
items.human_freeze_trigger: Any formula, unit, constant, state, precedence, profile, M6 binding, inferred input, or safety/accessibility claim.
